Home | The Haresfield Beacon Inn
Stay at the Beacon
Charming 19th-century country pub and hotel in Haresfield, South Gloucestershire, on the edge of the Cotswolds—perfect for walkers, cyclists, and countryside getaways.
See all rooms
Our rooms
The Haresfield Beacon has 8 beautifully designed, family friendly rooms to choose from all featuring en-suite bathrooms.
Each of the rooms at The Beacon & Railway Hotel has a traditional design, with modern touches. All rooms have en-suite bathrooms, free Wi-Fi, satellite TV and tea and coffee-making facilities.
